meta.name: skill-creator
meta.description: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Claude's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建和更新Claude技能的实用指南
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想扩展Claude的能力
copy.tagline_en: Create and update Claude skills with this guide.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to extend Claude's capabilities.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会指导你如何为它创建或更新技能。它会按照一系列步骤，帮你规划技能内容、生成模板、打包发布。
howto.when: 当你说出要创建或更新一个技能时触发，比如“帮我写个PDF处理技能”。

say.text: 帮我创建一个能处理PDF文件的技能。
我想更新我的BigQuery查询技能。
say.note: Claude会引导你修改现有技能

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude becomes a guide for creating or updating skills. It walks you through a process: understanding use cases, planning reusable resources, initializing a skill template, editing, and packaging.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you express an intent to create or update a skill, e.g., "Create a skill for PDF editing."

say_en.text: Create a skill that can edit PDF files.
say_en.note: Claude starts the skill creation process

say_en.text: I need to update my BigQuery query skill.
say_en.note: Claude guides you through modifying the existing skill
